title: Build Focus Guardian productivity monitoring application

requirements.text: Create backend data model to store user activity sessions including timestamp, application name, application category (productive/distracting), duration, and session type (focus/distraction/break)

quotes: The system does not record typed data or private information. It only detects: which application is active, how long it remains active, how frequently switching occurs

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores activity sessions with all required fields
Sessions can be queried by user and time range
Application categories are persisted (productive vs distracting)

requirements.text: Implement backend burnout index calculation logic that differentiates between productive-to-productive switching (small increase), productive-to-distracting switching (moderate increase), and distracting-to-distracting switching (large increase)

quotes: The burnout index estimates cognitive fatigue. It increases differently depending on the type of switching

acceptanceCriteria: Burnout index calculation uses switch frequency and application category transitions
Different burnout increment rates apply based on switching type
Burnout index is stored and retrievable per user session

requirements.text: Create backend endpoints to record context switches with timestamp, source application, target application, and calculated switch frequency metrics (switches per minute, switches per hour)

quotes: Each time the active window changes, a switch event is recorded. From this the system calculates: switches per minute, switches per hour

acceptanceCriteria: Switch events are recorded with source and target applications
Switch frequency metrics are calculated and stored
Switch history is queryable by time range

requirements.text: Implement backend achievement tracking system that awards focus streak badges, deep work hour milestones, and distraction resistance awards based on user behavior patterns

quotes: Users earn: Focus streak badges, Deep work hours milestones, Distraction resistance awards

acceptanceCriteria: Achievement types are defined with unlock criteria
User achievements are tracked and persisted
Achievements can be queried and displayed

requirements.text: Create backend break session tracking that records break type (desk recovery/walk break), duration, timer settings, and break quality classification (restorative vs non-restorative based on activity during break)

quotes: Not all breaks are restorative. Scrolling social media is not a true rest. A recovery pie chart shows: restorative breaks (walks, breathing, inactivity), non-restorative breaks (passive browsing)

acceptanceCriteria: Break sessions store type, duration, and quality classification
Break activity can be analyzed to determine restorative quality
Break data is aggregatable for visualization

requirements.text: Implement backend periodic report generation that analyzes positive patterns (consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions) and negative patterns (late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes)

quotes: The system generates a periodic report showing: Positive patterns: consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions; Negative patterns: late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes

acceptanceCriteria: Reports analyze session data to identify positive and negative patterns
Pattern detection algorithms identify work consistency, break timing, and distraction trends
Reports are generated for configurable time periods

requirements.text: Build application categorization interface where users can view and manage which applications are classified as productive or distracting, with default examples including coding tools, document editors, and presentation software as productive, and social media, video platforms, and games as distracting

quotes: Productive Apps: coding tools, document editors, presentation software, research websites, textbooks, PDF readers. Distracting Apps: social media, video platforms, entertainment websites, games, and messaging apps

acceptanceCriteria: Users can view categorized applications
Users can add new applications and assign categories
Users can edit existing application categories
Default productive and distracting apps are pre-populated

requirements.text: Create live monitoring simulation interface that displays current active application, real-time switching frequency, continuous focus duration, and a visual indicator when context switches occur

quotes: The app constantly checks the active window every few seconds. Each time the active window changes, a switch event is recorded

acceptanceCriteria: Current active application is displayed in real-time
Switch frequency metrics update live
Visual feedback indicates when switches occur
Continuous focus timer shows uninterrupted work duration

requirements.text: Implement progressive warning system UI that shows non-intrusive notifications at first burnout threshold displaying current burnout index and encouragement message, then applies subtle greyscale filter to screen at second threshold to reduce visual stimulation

quotes: First Threshold (Early Fatigue): A small notification appears, Burnout index is shown, User is encouraged to refocus. Second Threshold (High Fatigue): The screen slightly greyscales, Visual stimulation is reduced

acceptanceCriteria: First warning shows gentle notification with burnout index
Second warning applies greyscale visual effect to entire interface
Warnings are dismissible but reappear if behavior continues
Visual effects scale with burnout severity

requirements.text: Build smart blocking interface that after two ignored warnings displays a block screen for distracting applications, showing required productive session duration (20-25 minutes) needed to unlock, with a focus timer and progress indicator

quotes: After two warnings, the system temporarily blocks distracting applications. Unlock condition: The user must complete a productive session (for example 20–25 minutes of uninterrupted work)

acceptanceCriteria: Block screen activates after two warnings for distracting apps
Block screen displays required focus duration (20-25 minutes)
Timer counts down productive work session
Block is removed automatically after productive session completes

requirements.text: Create desk recovery break interface with guided breathing exercise animations, calming visual elements, and short mental reset timer that can be completed without leaving the workspace

quotes: The app offers: guided breathing exercises, calm focus visuals, short mental reset. These can be completed without leaving the desk

acceptanceCriteria: Breathing exercise displays animated visual guide
Interface uses calming colors and smooth animations
Short timer (3-5 minutes) tracks desk recovery duration
Break can be started and ended from main interface

requirements.text: Implement walk break timer interface where users set break duration before leaving, displays countdown timer prominently, and plays an alert alarm sound when time expires if user has not returned

quotes: If the user chooses to leave: they set a break timer, the app starts a countdown, if they do not return in time, an alert alarm plays

acceptanceCriteria: User can input desired break duration before starting walk break
Countdown timer is visible and updates in real-time
Alert sound plays when timer reaches zero
User can manually end break early if they return before timer expires

requirements.text: Build gamification achievements display showing earned badges for focus streaks, deep work milestones, and distraction resistance with visual icons, unlock dates, and share functionality for portfolio or interview use

quotes: Focus streak badges, Deep work hours milestones, Distraction resistance awards. These achievements can be shared or used as proof of work discipline (for example during interviews or portfolio demonstrations)

acceptanceCriteria: Achievements are displayed as visual badges with icons
Each achievement shows unlock date and criteria
Users can share achievements externally
Achievement progress is visible for locked badges

requirements.text: Create recovery quality visualization using a pie chart that segments break time into restorative activities (walks, breathing exercises, inactivity) and non-restorative activities (passive browsing, social media) with clear labels and percentages

quotes: A recovery pie chart shows: restorative breaks (walks, breathing, inactivity), non-restorative breaks (passive browsing)

acceptanceCriteria: Pie chart displays break quality distribution
Restorative and non-restorative segments are clearly differentiated
Percentages and time durations are labeled
Chart updates based on selected time period

requirements.text: Build comprehensive dashboard displaying total focus time, distraction time, switching frequency chart, burnout index trend graph, overall productivity score, and daily personalized recommendations in a clean visual layout

quotes: The home screen dashboard provides a full behavioral summary: total focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, burnout index trend, productivity score, daily recommendations. The dashboard should be simple and visual

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays all key metrics in organized card layout
Charts visualize trends over time (switching frequency, burnout index)
Productivity score is prominently displayed with visual indicator
Daily recommendations are personalized based on user patterns
Layout is clean and information is quickly scannable

requirements.text: Implement periodic report view that displays positive behavioral patterns (consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions) and negative patterns (late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes) with visual indicators and trend comparisons over time

quotes: The system generates a periodic report showing: Positive patterns: consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions; Negative patterns: late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes

acceptanceCriteria: Report displays positive patterns with encouraging visual indicators
Negative patterns are highlighted constructively for self-correction
Patterns show week-over-week or month-over-month comparisons
Report is exportable or viewable for different time periods

requirements.text: Design the application with a supportive coaching aesthetic using warm, encouraging colors and gentle typography that conveys non-intrusive monitoring, privacy-respecting tracking, and encouragement over punishment throughout all interfaces

quotes: The application should feel like a coach, not a supervisor. Important principles: Non-intrusive monitoring, Privacy-respecting tracking, Gentle nudges instead of harsh blocking, Encouragement over punishment

acceptanceCriteria: Visual design uses warm, supportive color palette (avoid harsh reds or aggressive tones)
Typography and language tone is encouraging and coaching-oriented
Interventions feel helpful rather than restrictive
Overall aesthetic conveys trust and personal growth support

constraints: The system must not record typed content, passwords, or private information - only application names and switching behavior
All monitoring must be local and privacy-respecting without external data transmission beyond Internet Computer backend
Blocking mechanisms must allow user override after completing productive sessions, not permanent blocks
Visual interventions (greyscale, notifications) must be subtle and non-disruptive to workflow
nonGoals: Real-time native desktop application monitoring (this will be simulated within the web application)
Integration with external productivity tools or calendar systems
AI-powered automatic application categorization (user must manually categorize)
